card.name: The @ sign in email addresses
card.fires_on: The @ symbol (or @example) inside an email address, right after the user name or the word email and before the domain.

modes.label: Real address @
modes.description: The @ between a user name and a domain in a written-out email address.

modes.label: Masked address
modes.description: The @example placeholder after the word email, with .com following.
modes.example: Cherie Campbell, Murray-Darling Freshwater Research Centre, Mildura, email<<@example>>.com.

card.plain: It marks the @ in an email address, the point where the domain name comes next.
